observations.says: at three o'clock on Wednesday, the draper's shop in Fore Street was untouched but for the loose board, the till with two pounds of silver as it was left
from last month, the hiding-place under the loose board was a secret told to one person only
from two o'clock on Wednesday until three o'clock on Wednesday, Jane Marsh was at St. Mary's
from one o'clock on Wednesday until four o'clock on Wednesday, Dick was at Hilltop
when the letter came, Jane Marsh read aloud the letter about the hiding-place at Jane Marsh's house; from when the letter came, Mr. Voss knew the hiding-place under the loose board
